# Architecture

## What This Project Does

Compiles historical West Nile virus mosquito trap data from multiple surveillance contractors
(VDCI, CMC, CFC, Boulder County) spanning 2006–present into a single rectangular dataset. The key
challenge is accounting for *every* trap *every* week — distinguishing a trap that caught zero
mosquitoes from one that was never set out — so that mean mosquitoes-per-trap-night abundance
calculations are correct.

## Entry Points

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| [pipelines/pipeline_combine_culex_sheet.qmd](../../pipelines/pipeline_combine_culex_sheet.qmd) | Main pipeline — render in RStudio or via `quarto render` |
| [config/config_culex_combine.yml](../../config/config_culex_combine.yml) | All tunable parameters: source paths, week range, output paths, species levels |

## Pipeline Stages

Stages execute top-to-bottom when the QMD is rendered. Each is delimited by a `#---` comment header.

| Stage | Chunk label | What it does |
|-------|-------------|--------------|
| 1 | `environment` | Load packages, source all R/ functions |
| 2 | `config` | Read YAML config, initialise manifest |
| 3 | `import` | Load trap reference, historical database, column-rename table |
| 4 | `per_source_import` | Read each source folder, dispatch pivot functions → `sources_raw` |
| 5 | `expand_grid` | Build rectangular skeleton: trap × year × week × spp via `expand_trap()` |
| 6 | `per_source_clean` | Normalise columns, parse dates, classify spp/method/status, deduplicate |
| 7 | `per_source_prep` | Expand status rows to all spp levels via `prep_for_skeleton()` |
| 8 | `per_source_filter` | Apply active-trap filter per source (driven by `filter_active` in config) |
| 9 | `reformat_datasheet` | Reshape historical pool database to match culex-sheet format |
| 10 | `join_datasheet_and_culex` | Full-join culex + database on (trap_id, spp, year, week) for QC |
| 11 | `join_into_skeleton` | Priority-fill skeleton: VDCI → CMC → CFC → BC → database |
| 12 | `post_expand_status` | Resolve NA trap_status, run 6 integrity assertions, write final output |

## Components

### Input Sources (`1_input/`)

Each source now lives in its own flat folder — no more nested `WNV-s YYYY/Week WW/` subdirs.

| Folder | Contractor | Format | Years |
|--------|-----------|--------|-------|
| `vdci/` | VDCI (current) | Long CSV | 2019–present |
| `cmc/` | CMC (prior) | Wide XLS | 2015–2018 |
| `cfc/` | CFC consolidated | Wide XLSX | 2006–2017 |
| `bc/` | Boulder County | CSV / XLSX | 2021–present |

Static reference files (also in `1_input/`):
- `foco_trap - data.csv` — authoritative trap registry (trap_id, zone, active, start_year)
- `wnv-s_database - data.csv` — historical pooled abundance (fallback source)
- `database_column_rename.csv` — column name translation table

### R Functions (`R/`)

27 functions across 27 files, organised by concern:

| Group | Functions |
|-------|-----------|
| Ingestion | `read_source()`, `read_list()`, `pivot_cmc()`, `pivot_cfc()`, `pivot_boulder()` |
| Cleaning | `key_rename()`, `wnv_s_clean()`, `make_key()`, `culex_dedup()`, `parse_flexible_date()`, `fix_zone_from_ref()`, `clean_summary()` |
| Structuring | `expand_trap()`, `prep_for_skeleton()`, `rowwise_expand()` |
| Filtering | `filter_culex_sheet()`, `rm_grp_na()` |
| Joining | `fill_skeleton()`, `collect_unmerged()`, `join_cxsheet_database()`, `bind_culex_sheets()`, `reformat_database_2_culex_sheet()` |
| Validation | `assign_trap_status_post_expand()` |
| Manifest | `manifest_init()`, `manifest_log()`, `inventory_source()` |
| Plotting | `plot_all_spp()`, `plot_culex_datasheet_comp()`, `plot_n()`, `plot_n_trap()` |

### Outputs

| Dir | Key files | Purpose |
|-----|-----------|---------|
| `2_mid/` | `unmerged_data.csv`, `dropped_by_active_filter.csv`, plots | Audit and diagnostic intermediates |
| `3_output/` | `culex_sheet_database_expand.csv` (main), `_manifest.txt`, plots | Final deliverables |

## How Components Connect

```
1_input/
  vdci/ cmc/ cfc/ bc/               ← raw source files (flat per-source folders)
         ↓
  [read_source + pivot_*]            ← per-source ingestion  →  sources_raw
         ↓
  [key_rename, wnv_s_clean,
   make_key, culex_dedup]            ← canonical cleaning    →  sources_cleaned
         ↓
  [prep_for_skeleton]                ← spp-level expansion   →  sources_prepped
         ↓
  [filter_culex_sheet]               ← active-trap filter    →  sources_filtered
         ↓
  [expand_trap] → trap_skeleton      ← all (trap×week×spp) cells
         ↓
  [fill_skeleton]                    ← priority join: VDCI > CMC > CFC > BC > database
         ↓
  [assign_trap_status_post_expand]
  + 6 stopifnot() assertions
         ↓
  3_output/culex_sheet_database_expand.csv   ← FINAL OUTPUT
```
